description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the RecognizeDriverLicense operation for driver's license recognition
description_zh: 本文介绍驾驶证识别RecognizeDriverLicense的语法及示例
name: RecognizeDriverLicense

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS link is not in the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the uploaded photo is the main page or the supplementary page of the driver's license.

- face: main page

- back: supplementary page
parameters.help_zh:
上传照片为驾驶证首页或者副页。

- face：首页

- back：副页
parameters.name: side
